transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... my wife wanted me to come. I guess... this memorial I'm putting together for my brother, it's just... gotten a bit bigger than I originally planned. I've been spending most of my days on it. You know, tracking down the right songs, calling up people, figuring out displays, and planning some trips for it. My wife says I've just... stopped doing everything else. The garden, my walking group... she thinks it's too much. So, here I am.
Do you feel like every detail of the memorial has to be just right?
Well... I don't know about that. I'm just... doing what needs to be done for it. I haven't really thought about it having to be perfect or anything like that. I'm just working on it.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable when you think about the memorial not going exactly as planned?
No... not really. I mean, it's just a memorial. I'm not... losing sleep over it being perfect or anything. I just want to get it done.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or ideas that you feel compelled to act on while planning the memorial?
No... I don't have anything like that. I just work on the memorial. Nothing is forcing me to do it, if that's what you mean.
Do you think about the memorial even when you're not actively working on it?
No, not really. When I'm done working on it for the day, I just... put it away. I don't sit around dwelling on it.
Has your focus on the memorial caused problems in your relationships or daily life?

Well, my wife thinks so. She says our whole day is just... her trying to calm me down or stop me from making another phone call or getting into an argument about it. And I guess I haven't been to my walking group or the book club lately. The garden's a bit of a mess. Some folks at the senior center are upset with me because... well, I guess I talk about the display a lot. But I don't know if I'd call it a problem.
Do you feel like you can stop working on the memorial at any time if you wanted to?
I suppose so. If I wanted to. But... I don't want to. It needs to be done.
Do you feel like you're doing this memorial for your brother or for someone else?
It's... for him. I don't know who else it would be for.
Do you feel guilty if you're not working on the memorial?
Guilty? No... I wouldn't say that. I don't really think about it like that. I just... do the work.
Do you feel like you have to be in charge of the memorial planning?
I don't know about being in charge. I'm just the one doing it.
Do you feel like you must control every aspect of the memorial planning?
Not really. I just... do what needs to be done. Like I said, it's just me doing it, so... I don't think about it like control.
Do you think someone else could do a good job planning the memorial if you weren't doing it?
I suppose they could. I just haven't really thought about anyone else doing it.
Do you think the memorial would be less meaningful if someone else made some of the decisions about how it's planned?
I don't know... maybe. I haven't really thought about it like that. It's just my responsibility, that's all.
Do you think the memorial would be perfect if you had help from others in planning it?
I... I'm not sure. I haven't really thought about it being perfect, or... or who else would even help. It's just something I have to do.
Do you feel like something bad would happen if you didn't complete the memorial as planned?
I don't know about anything bad. I just... I need to finish it. That's all.
Do you think your brother would be disappointed if the memorial wasn't done exactly the way you're planning it?
I don't... I can't really say. I can't ask him, so... I just know how it needs to be done. I'm not really thinking about all that other stuff.
Do you feel like you're doing the memorial planning because you genuinely want to honor your brother, or because you feel like you have to for some other reason?
I... I don't really know how to answer that. I just want to do it. For him, I guess. I haven't really thought about it being for some other reason.
Do you feel like you're doing the memorial planning to get rid of unwanted thoughts or feelings?
No, it's... it's not like that. I'm just doing it because it needs to get done. I don't... I'm not trying to get rid of anything.
Do you feel like the memorial planning is taking over other parts of your life because you're trying to make sure everything is just right?
I don't think so. I'm just... I'm just trying to get it done. It's not taking over anything, it's just what I'm doing right now.
Do you feel like something is compelling you to continue planning the memorial?
Compelling me? No... I don't know what you mean by that. Nobody is making me do it. It's just... it's just something I'm doing. That's all.
